Add a document to docs/

Category
practice
Goal
a new document renders complete from file://, sits in its chapter, and is committed with its catalogue row
Source
docs/README.md; templates/
Updated
2026-08-02
Commit
6b7821c

Every document here starts as a copy of its chapter's template, which is itself a filled example. The whole procedure is three steps and one commit.

Prerequisites

  • A branch off the workspace root's main — the installed guard blocks direct commits to main (~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, "Code to work").

Steps

  1. Copy the chapter's template to the document's stable name. If the document records or argues a decision, take templates/principle.html; if it draws a structure, templates/pattern.html; if it walks a procedure, templates/practice.html. The name is <plane>-<kebab-slice>.html, where the plane prefix is agent- or service-. 

    cp docs/templates/practice.html docs/service-example-slice.html

  2. Replace the example content with your own, keep every required section, and delete every authoring comment. The contract sits at the top of the template you copied; a clean document has no comment left.

    • A webfont, CDN link, or script breaks the file:// rule — the page must open with no network, so keep everything inline.
    grep -c '<!--' docs/service-example-slice.html
0

  3. Add the document's row under its chapter in INDEX.md, then commit both files in one change and merge the branch. 

    git add docs/service-example-slice.html docs/INDEX.md
git commit -m "docs: add service-example-slice"

Acceptance

Open the file from file:// with the network off: the page renders complete, and nothing pans sideways at phone width. INDEX.md lists the document under exactly one chapter, in the same commit.

Recovery

  • The commit was refused with a main-branch message: you are on main. Create the branch now and repeat the commit — the staged files survive the switch.
  • A table pans the whole page sideways on a phone: the template's table CSS is missing or was edited out — restore the @media (max-width: 42rem) block from the template.
